definitions.explanation: A sound made by something, especially an unexpected or unidentified noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物音|ものおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧して⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めた→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up because of a noise in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {物音|ものおと}ひとつしない⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a quiet night without a single sound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{物音|ものおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear sounds from the next room.

notes:
{物音|ものおと} refers to an unidentified or unexpected sound — the kind of noise that catches your attention because you don't immediately know what caused it. Composed of ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing) + ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ (sound).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {物音|ものおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧する: a sound is heard
- {物音|ものおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a noise
